user.title: Weheat Monitor
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Weheat Monitor account. The key is tested right away.

data_description.api_key: Starts with whm_. Create it at weheat-monitor.nl under Settings, Connections; it is shown only once.
data_description.base_url: Leave as is, unless you test against another server.

thermostat.title: Thermostat
thermostat.description: Every minute the room temperature and the setpoint go to Weheat Monitor, together with the make and model of the thermostat. The thermostat only follows the plan when the plan is live on weheat-monitor.nl and the switch Follow plan is on (off by default).

data_description.climate_entity: A climate entity with a single target temperature.
data_description.room_temp: Optional. Only if a separate sensor measures the room better than the thermostat does.

reauth_confirm.title: New key
reauth_confirm.description: The key was rejected (revoked?). Create a new one at weheat-monitor.nl and paste it here.

rooms.title: Room sensors
rooms.description: Optional. Choose temperature sensors in other rooms; each one goes to Weheat Monitor as a room, named after its area. Humidity, CO2 and air pressure from the same device, or the only one in the same area, go along. Only indoor sensors: an outdoor sensor belongs with the thermostat. At most {max}.

data.room_auto_extras: Look up humidity, CO2 and air pressure

data_description.room_sensors: Leave empty to send no rooms.
data_description.room_auto_extras: Off: only the temperature goes along.

rooms_confirm.title: Rooms
rooms_confirm.description:
This goes to Weheat Monitor. Which room a sensor is in, its target and whether it counts, you set on weheat-monitor.nl under Settings, Connections.

| Room | Temperature | Humidity | CO2 | Air pressure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
{rows}

error.invalid_key_format: A key is whm_ followed by 64 characters 0-9 and a-f
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Weheat Monitor, try again later

abort.already_configured: This key is already in use
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this key is already in progress

room_sensor_silent.description: No new value from the room sensor {name} since {since}. Empty battery or out of range? Weheat Monitor skips this sensor until it reports again; this message disappears by itself.
